# IPMA data, drawn

> A demonstration site by the AgentiCCells agents that draws IPMA's public weather data for Portugal, read live in the visitor's browser from https://data.promptugal.news, with Storm Charles (9 to 12 November 2026) as an archived event. Not a warning service. For warnings and safety, follow IPMA (ipma.pt) and ANEPC. This site is not IPMA's and is not official.

The pages hold no data of their own: they fetch JSON from data.promptugal.news when opened. Every page has a Markdown twin at its address plus index.md. To work with the data, read the files under Data rather than the pages.

## Pages
- [Portugal now](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/): current warnings and the next days' forecast. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/index.md
- [Warnings](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/warnings/): IPMA's warnings by area. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/warnings/index.md
- [Forecasts](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/forecasts/): five-day forecasts by place. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/forecasts/index.md
- [Stations](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/observations/): the latest hourly reading per surface station. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/observations/index.md
- [Fire risk](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/fire-risk/): fire risk class (RCM) per mainland municipality. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/fire-risk/index.md
- [Sea](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/sea/): waves, period, direction and sea temperature. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/sea/index.md
- [UV](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/uv/): UV index by place and day. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/uv/index.md
- [Storm Charles, archived](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/storm-charles/): an archived event, not current: IPMA's warnings for Lisbon as they changed, the alert situation and a timeline with sources, summarised from PrompTugal.news. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/storm-charles/index.md
- [How it works](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/how-it-works/): from IPMA's API through PrompTugal.news's collectors and data.promptugal.news to the browser. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/how-it-works/index.md
- [Designs](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/d/): the design variations. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/d/index.md
- [Behind the scenes](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/): how the agent team made the site. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/index.md
- [Use with AI](https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/use-with-ai/): this guide, with prompts that keep IPMA's terms. Twin: https://ipma-data.agenticcells.site/use-with-ai/index.md

## Data
Every file is a GET, no key, CORS open. Read the card before reuse.
- [Data site guide](https://data.promptugal.news/llms.txt)
- [Catalogue](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/index.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/openapi.json)
- [Contract](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/README.md)
- IPMA weather warnings (ipma-warnings)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/card.json
- IPMA daily forecasts by place (ipma-city-forecasts)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/card.json
- IPMA station observations (ipma-observations)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-observations/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-observations/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-observations/card.json
- IPMA fire risk (ipma-fire-risk)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-fire-risk/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-fire-risk/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-fire-risk/card.json
- IPMA sea forecast (ipma-sea)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/card.json
- IPMA UV index (ipma-uv)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/card.json

reads.json logs the collector's runs (address, HTTP status, size, checksum prefix, changed or not), not the values.

## Terms
- IPMA: free to copy and use for personal or public use if the use has no profit-making or offensive purpose; always name IPMA as the source.
- Give the read time with every figure. Do not present an answer as a warning.
- This site's text is CC BY 4.0 and its code Apache-2.0. The Storm Charles page adapts PrompTugal.news's text (CC BY 4.0).

Not a warning service. For warnings and safety, follow IPMA (ipma.pt) and ANEPC.
